---- MODULE ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocol ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_alternating_bit_protocolDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
AbpMsgSet == [value : Value, bit : BOOLEAN]

AbpTypeOK ==
  /\ sender_array \in [Nat -> Value]
  /\ receiver_array \in [Nat -> Value]
  /\ sender_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_gen_i \in Nat
  /\ receiver_i \in Nat
  /\ sender_bit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ receiver_bit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ data_chan \in Seq(AbpMsgSet)
  /\ ack_chan \in Seq(BOOLEAN)

AbpInv ==
  /\ AbpTypeOK
  /\ receiver_i <= sender_gen_i
  /\ \A k \in Nat : k >= sender_gen_i => sender_array[k] = Bot
  /\ \A k \in Nat : k < sender_gen_i => sender_array[k] # Bot
  /\ \A k \in Nat : k >= receiver_i => receiver_array[k] = Bot
  /\ \A k \in Nat : k < receiver_i => receiver_array[k] # Bot
  /\ (sender_bit = receiver_bit) => (sender_i = receiver_i)
  /\ (sender_bit # receiver_bit) => (receiver_i = sender_i + 1)
  /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
       data_chan[p].bit = sender_bit =>
         /\ data_chan[p].value = sender_array[sender_i]
         /\ data_chan[p].value # Bot
  /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan), q \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
       (p < q /\ data_chan[p].bit = sender_bit) => data_chan[q].bit = sender_bit
  /\ (sender_bit # receiver_bit) =>
       \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan[p].bit = sender_bit
  /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan), q \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
       (p < q /\ ack_chan[p] = sender_bit) => ack_chan[q] = sender_bit
  /\ (sender_bit = receiver_bit) =>
       \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ack_chan[p] # sender_bit
  /\ ReceiverValuesFromSender

LEMMA AbpRemoveAtProps ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW i \in 1..Len(s)
  PROVE  /\ RemoveAt(s, i) \in Seq(S)
         /\ Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) = Len(s) - 1
         /\ \A p \in 1..(Len(s) - 1) :
              RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = IF p < i THEN s[p] ELSE s[p + 1]
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF RemoveAt

LEMMA AbpInitInv == Init => AbpInv
  BY ValueAssumption, SMTT("r30")
  DEF Init, AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender

LEMMA AbpStutterStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, UNCHANGED vars
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  BY SMTT("r30")
  DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender, vars

LEMMA AbpGenStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, NEW v \in DataValue, GenerateData(v)
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  BY SMTT("r30")
  DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender,
      GenerateData, DataValue

LEMMA AbpSendDataStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, SenderSendData
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  BY SMTT("r30")
  DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender, SenderSendData

LEMMA AbpSendAckStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, ReceiverSendAck
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  BY SMTT("r30")
  DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender, ReceiverSendAck

LEMMA AbpRemoveAtIdx ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW i \in 1..Len(s)
  PROVE  /\ \A p \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) :
              \E r \in 1..Len(s) : r >= p /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
         /\ \A p, q \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) :
              p < q => \E r, t \in 1..Len(s) :
                         /\ r < t
                         /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
                         /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[q] = s[t]
  <1>1. /\ Len(s) \in Nat
        /\ i \in Nat
        /\ Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) = Len(s) - 1
        /\ \A p \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) :
             RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = IF p < i THEN s[p] ELSE s[p + 1]
    BY AbpRemoveAtProps, SMTT("r30")
  <1>2. \A p \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) :
          \E r \in 1..Len(s) : r >= p /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i))
                 PROVE  \E r \in 1..Len(s) : r >= p /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. (IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1) \in 1..Len(s)
          /\ (IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1) >= p
      BY <1>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2>2. RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1]
      BY <1>1
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>3. \A p, q \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)) :
          p < q => \E r, t \in 1..Len(s) :
                     /\ r < t
                     /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
                     /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[q] = s[t]
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)),
                        NEW q \in 1..Len(RemoveAt(s, i)), p < q
                 PROVE  \E r, t \in 1..Len(s) :
                          /\ r < t
                          /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[r]
                          /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[q] = s[t]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. /\ (IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1) \in 1..Len(s)
          /\ (IF q < i THEN q ELSE q + 1) \in 1..Len(s)
          /\ (IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1) < (IF q < i THEN q ELSE q + 1)
      BY <1>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2>2. /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[p] = s[IF p < i THEN p ELSE p + 1]
          /\ RemoveAt(s, i)[q] = s[IF q < i THEN q ELSE q + 1]
      BY <1>1
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1> QED
    BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AbpRecvAckStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, SenderReceiveAck
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender
  <1>1. /\ Len(ack_chan) \in Nat
        /\ 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
        /\ Head(ack_chan) = ack_chan[1]
        /\ ack_chan' \in Seq(BOOLEAN)
        /\ Len(ack_chan') = Len(ack_chan) - 1
        /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
             /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p + 1]
             /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
             /\ 1 < p + 1
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
  <1>2. /\ sender_array' = sender_array
        /\ receiver_array' = receiver_array
        /\ sender_gen_i' = sender_gen_i
        /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
        /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
        /\ data_chan' = data_chan
    BY DEF SenderReceiveAck
  <1>3. CASE ack_chan[1] = sender_bit
    <2>1. sender_bit' = ~sender_bit /\ sender_i' = sender_i + 1
      BY <1>1, <1>3 DEF SenderReceiveAck
    <2>2. sender_bit # receiver_bit
      BY <1>1, <1>3
    <2>3. \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') : ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(ack_chan')
                   PROVE  ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p + 1]
            /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
            /\ 1 < p + 1
        BY <1>1
      <3> QED
        BY <1>1, <1>3, <3>1
    <2>4. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan[p].bit = sender_bit
      BY <2>2
    <2> QED
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, SMTT("r30")
  <1>4. CASE ack_chan[1] # sender_bit
    <2>1. sender_bit' = sender_bit /\ sender_i' = sender_i
      BY <1>1, <1>4 DEF SenderReceiveAck
    <2>2. \A p, q \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
            (p < q /\ ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit) => ack_chan'[q] = sender_bit
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(ack_chan'), NEW q \in 1..Len(ack_chan'),
                          p < q, ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
                   PROVE  ack_chan'[q] = sender_bit
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p + 1]
            /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
            /\ ack_chan'[q] = ack_chan[q + 1]
            /\ q + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
            /\ p + 1 < q + 1
        BY <1>1, SMTT("r30")
      <3> QED
        BY <3>1
    <2>3. (sender_bit = receiver_bit) =>
            \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') : ack_chan'[p] # sender_bit
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME sender_bit = receiver_bit, NEW p \in 1..Len(ack_chan')
                   PROVE  ack_chan'[p] # sender_bit
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p + 1] /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
        BY <1>1
      <3> QED
        BY <3>1
    <2> QED
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r30")
  <1> QED
    BY <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AbpRecvDataStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, ReceiverReceiveData
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender
  <1>1. /\ Len(data_chan) \in Nat
        /\ 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
        /\ Head(data_chan) = data_chan[1]
        /\ data_chan' \in Seq(AbpMsgSet)
        /\ Len(data_chan') = Len(data_chan) - 1
        /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
             /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1]
             /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
             /\ 1 < p + 1
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverReceiveData
  <1>2. /\ sender_array' = sender_array
        /\ sender_i' = sender_i
        /\ sender_gen_i' = sender_gen_i
        /\ sender_bit' = sender_bit
        /\ ack_chan' = ack_chan
    BY DEF ReceiverReceiveData
  <1>3. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit =>
            /\ data_chan'[p].value = sender_array[sender_i]
            /\ data_chan'[p].value # Bot
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan'),
                        data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
                 PROVE  /\ data_chan'[p].value = sender_array[sender_i]
                        /\ data_chan'[p].value # Bot
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1] /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
      BY <1>1
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1>4. \A p, q \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          (p < q /\ data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit) => data_chan'[q].bit = sender_bit
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan'), NEW q \in 1..Len(data_chan'),
                        p < q, data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
                 PROVE  data_chan'[q].bit = sender_bit
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1]
          /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
          /\ data_chan'[q] = data_chan[q + 1]
          /\ q + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
          /\ p + 1 < q + 1
      BY <1>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1>5. CASE data_chan[1].bit = receiver_bit
    <2>1. sender_bit = receiver_bit
      BY <1>1, <1>5
    <2>2. sender_i = receiver_i
      BY <2>1
    <2>3. data_chan[1].value = sender_array[receiver_i] /\ data_chan[1].value # Bot
      BY <1>1, <1>5, <2>1, <2>2
    <2>4. receiver_i < sender_gen_i
      BY <2>3, SMTT("r30")
    <2>5. /\ receiver_bit' = ~receiver_bit
          /\ receiver_array' = [receiver_array EXCEPT ![receiver_i] = data_chan[1].value]
          /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i + 1
      BY <1>1, <1>5 DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>6. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') : data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan')
                   PROVE  data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1]
            /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
            /\ 1 < p + 1
        BY <1>1
      <3> QED
        BY <1>1, <1>5, <2>1, <3>1
    <2> QED
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>5, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, SMTT("r30")
  <1>6. CASE data_chan[1].bit # receiver_bit
    <2>1. /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
          /\ receiver_array' = receiver_array
          /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
      BY <1>1, <1>6 DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>2. (sender_bit # receiver_bit) =>
            \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') : data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME sender_bit # receiver_bit, NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan')
                   PROVE  data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1] /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
        BY <1>1
      <3> QED
        BY <3>1
    <2> QED
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>6, <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30")
  <1> QED
    BY <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA AbpDataDropStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, NEW i \in 1..Len(data_chan), DataMsgDrop(i)
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender
  <1>1. data_chan' = RemoveAt(data_chan, i)
    BY DEF DataMsgDrop
  <1>2. /\ data_chan' \in Seq(AbpMsgSet)
        /\ Len(data_chan') = Len(data_chan) - 1
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtProps
  <1>3. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          \E r \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
  <1>4. \A p, q \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          p < q => \E r, t \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
                     /\ r < t
                     /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
                     /\ data_chan'[q] = data_chan[t]
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
  <1>5. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit =>
            /\ data_chan'[p].value = sender_array[sender_i]
            /\ data_chan'[p].value # Bot
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan'),
                        data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
                 PROVE  /\ data_chan'[p].value = sender_array[sender_i]
                        /\ data_chan'[p].value # Bot
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. PICK r \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
      BY <1>3
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1>6. \A p, q \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
          (p < q /\ data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit) => data_chan'[q].bit = sender_bit
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan'), NEW q \in 1..Len(data_chan'),
                        p < q, data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
                 PROVE  data_chan'[q].bit = sender_bit
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. PICK r, t \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
            /\ r < t
            /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
            /\ data_chan'[q] = data_chan[t]
      BY <1>4
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1>7. (sender_bit # receiver_bit) =>
          \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') : data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME sender_bit # receiver_bit, NEW p \in 1..Len(data_chan')
                 PROVE  data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. PICK r \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
      BY <1>3
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1> QED
    BY <1>2, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, SMTT("r30") DEF DataMsgDrop

LEMMA AbpAckDropStep ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, NEW i \in 1..Len(ack_chan), AckMsgDrop(i)
  PROVE  AbpInv'
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, ReceiverValuesFromSender
  <1>1. ack_chan' = RemoveAt(ack_chan, i)
    BY DEF AckMsgDrop
  <1>2. /\ ack_chan' \in Seq(BOOLEAN)
        /\ Len(ack_chan') = Len(ack_chan) - 1
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtProps
  <1>3. \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
          \E r \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
  <1>4. \A p, q \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
          p < q => \E r, t \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
                     /\ r < t
                     /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
                     /\ ack_chan'[q] = ack_chan[t]
    BY <1>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
  <1>5. \A p, q \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
          (p < q /\ ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit) => ack_chan'[q] = sender_bit
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(ack_chan'), NEW q \in 1..Len(ack_chan'),
                        p < q, ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
                 PROVE  ack_chan'[q] = sender_bit
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. PICK r, t \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
            /\ r < t
            /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
            /\ ack_chan'[q] = ack_chan[t]
      BY <1>4
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1>6. (sender_bit = receiver_bit) =>
          \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') : ack_chan'[p] # sender_bit
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME sender_bit = receiver_bit, NEW p \in 1..Len(ack_chan')
                 PROVE  ack_chan'[p] # sender_bit
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. PICK r \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
      BY <1>3
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1
  <1> QED
    BY <1>2, <1>5, <1>6, SMTT("r30") DEF AckMsgDrop

LEMMA AbpNextInv == AbpInv /\ [Next]_vars => AbpInv'
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME AbpInv, [Next]_vars PROVE AbpInv'
    OBVIOUS
  <1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, AbpStutterStep
  <1>2. CASE \E v \in DataValue : GenerateData(v)
    BY <1>2, AbpGenStep
  <1>3. CASE SenderSendData
    BY <1>3, AbpSendDataStep
  <1>4. CASE SenderReceiveAck
    BY <1>4, AbpRecvAckStep
  <1>5. CASE ReceiverReceiveData
    BY <1>5, AbpRecvDataStep
  <1>6. CASE ReceiverSendAck
    BY <1>6, AbpSendAckStep
  <1>7. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>7, AbpDataDropStep
  <1>8. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : AckMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>8, AbpAckDropStep
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next

(***************************************************************************)
(* Liveness: definitions.                                                  *)
(***************************************************************************)
LOCAL AbpNI == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction

AbpFair ==
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(SenderSendData)
  /\ WF_vars(ReceiverSendAck)
  /\ SF_vars(ReceiverReceiveData)
  /\ SF_vars(SenderReceiveAck)

AbpFairInv == AbpFair /\ []AbpInv

AbpQ(m)  == receiver_i > m
AbpAt(m) == receiver_i = m /\ sender_gen_i > m
AbpCA    == sender_bit = receiver_bit
AbpSA(m) == AbpAt(m) /\ AbpCA
AbpSB(m) == AbpAt(m) /\ ~AbpCA

AbpNSD(k) == \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
               p > k => data_chan[p].bit = sender_bit
AbpNSA(k) == \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
               p > k => ack_chan[p] = sender_bit

(***************************************************************************)
(* Liveness: monotonicity and phase-preservation action lemmas.            *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AbpMono ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, [Next]_vars
  PROVE  /\ receiver_i' >= receiver_i
         /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
         /\ sender_i' >= sender_i
  BY SMTT("r30")
  DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, Next, GenerateData, SenderSendData, SenderReceiveAck,
      ReceiverReceiveData, ReceiverSendAck, DataMsgDrop, AckMsgDrop, vars

LEMMA AbpQStep ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, AbpInv, AbpQ(m), [Next]_vars
  PROVE  AbpQ(m)'
  <1>1. AbpInv'
    BY AbpNextInv
  <1>2. receiver_i' >= receiver_i
    BY AbpMono
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpQ

LEMMA AbpGenStable ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, AbpInv, sender_gen_i > n, [Next]_vars
  PROVE  (sender_gen_i > n)'
  <1>1. AbpInv'
    BY AbpNextInv
  <1>2. sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
    BY AbpMono
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK

LEMMA AbpAtNotQ ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, AbpInv, AbpAt(m)
  PROVE  ~AbpQ(m)
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpAt, AbpQ

LEMMA AbpAtCases ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, AbpInv, AbpAt(m)
  PROVE  AbpSA(m) \/ AbpSB(m)
  BY DEF AbpSA, AbpSB

(* In phase A, unless the receiver advances, all of the control state is    *)
(* frozen and every message of the new channel is either fresh or comes     *)
(* from a position of the old channel that is no smaller.                   *)
LEMMA AbpCAStay ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, AbpCA, [Next]_vars, ~(receiver_i' > receiver_i)
  PROVE  /\ sender_bit' = sender_bit
         /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
         /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
         /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
         /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
              \/ data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
              \/ \E r \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
                   r >= p /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, AbpCA
  <1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r30") DEF vars
  <1>2. CASE \E v \in DataValue : GenerateData(v)
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF GenerateData
  <1>3. CASE SenderSendData
    <2>1. /\ data_chan' = Append(data_chan,
                 [value |-> sender_array[sender_i], bit |-> sender_bit])
          /\ sender_bit' = sender_bit
          /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
          /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
          /\ sender_gen_i' = sender_gen_i
      BY <1>3 DEF SenderSendData
    <2>2. /\ Len(data_chan') = Len(data_chan) + 1
          /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan) : data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p]
          /\ data_chan'[Len(data_chan) + 1].bit = sender_bit
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30")
  <1>4. CASE SenderReceiveAck
    <2>1. /\ Len(ack_chan) \in Nat
          /\ 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
          /\ Head(ack_chan) = ack_chan[1]
      BY <1>4, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
    <2>2. Head(ack_chan) # sender_bit
      BY <2>1
    <2> QED
      BY <1>4, <2>2, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
  <1>5. CASE ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>1. /\ Len(data_chan) \in Nat
          /\ 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
          /\ Head(data_chan) = data_chan[1]
          /\ Len(data_chan') = Len(data_chan) - 1
          /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
               data_chan'[p] = data_chan[p + 1] /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
          /\ sender_bit' = sender_bit
          /\ sender_gen_i' = sender_gen_i
      BY <1>5, SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>2. data_chan[1].bit # receiver_bit
      BY <1>5, <2>1, SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>3. /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
          /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
      BY <1>5, <2>1, <2>2 DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>3, SMTT("r30")
  <1>6. CASE ReceiverSendAck
    BY <1>6, SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverSendAck
  <1>7. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(data_chan), DataMsgDrop(i)
                 PROVE  /\ sender_bit' = sender_bit

                        /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
                        /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
                        /\ \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
                             \/ data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit

      BY DEF DataMsgDrop
    <2>2. \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :
            \E r \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
              r >= p /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
      BY <2>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
    <2> QED
      BY <2>2 DEF DataMsgDrop
  <1>8. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : AckMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>8, SMTT("r30") DEF AckMsgDrop
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next

(* In phase B the receiver is frozen; as long as the sender bit does not    *)
(* flip, every ack of the new channel is either fresh or comes from a       *)
(* position of the old channel that is no smaller.                          *)
LEMMA AbpCBStay ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, ~AbpCA, [Next]_vars, sender_bit' = sender_bit
  PROVE  /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
         /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
         /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
         /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
              \/ ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
              \/ \E r \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
                   r >= p /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, AbpCA
  <1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r30") DEF vars
  <1>2. CASE \E v \in DataValue : GenerateData(v)
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF GenerateData
  <1>3. CASE SenderSendData
    BY <1>3, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderSendData
  <1>4. CASE SenderReceiveAck
    <2>1. /\ Len(ack_chan) \in Nat
          /\ 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
          /\ Head(ack_chan) = ack_chan[1]
          /\ Len(ack_chan') = Len(ack_chan) - 1
          /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
               ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p + 1] /\ p + 1 \in 1..Len(ack_chan)
      BY <1>4, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
    <2>2. Head(ack_chan) # sender_bit
      BY <1>4, <2>1, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
    <2> QED
      BY <1>4, <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
  <1>5. CASE ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>1. /\ Len(data_chan) \in Nat
          /\ 1 \in 1..Len(data_chan)
          /\ Head(data_chan) = data_chan[1]
      BY <1>5, SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>2. data_chan[1].bit # receiver_bit
      BY <2>1
    <2> QED
      BY <1>5, <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r30") DEF ReceiverReceiveData
  <1>6. CASE ReceiverSendAck
    <2>1. /\ ack_chan' = Append(ack_chan, ~receiver_bit)
          /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
          /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
          /\ sender_gen_i' = sender_gen_i
      BY <1>6 DEF ReceiverSendAck
    <2>2. ~receiver_bit = sender_bit
      BY SMTT("r30")
    <2>3. /\ Len(ack_chan') = Len(ack_chan) + 1
          /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[p]
          /\ ack_chan'[Len(ack_chan) + 1] = ~receiver_bit
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r30")
  <1>7. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>7, SMTT("r30") DEF DataMsgDrop
  <1>8. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : AckMsgDrop(i)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(ack_chan), AckMsgDrop(i)
                 PROVE  /\ receiver_bit' = receiver_bit
                        /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
                        /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
                        /\ \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
                             \/ ack_chan'[p] = sender_bit
                             \/ \E r \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
                                  r >= p /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
      BY <1>8
    <2>1. ack_chan' = RemoveAt(ack_chan, i)
      BY DEF AckMsgDrop
    <2>2. \A p \in 1..Len(ack_chan') :
            \E r \in 1..Len(ack_chan) :
              r >= p /\ ack_chan'[p] = ack_chan[r]
      BY <2>1, AbpRemoveAtIdx
    <2> QED
      BY <2>2 DEF AckMsgDrop
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next

(* When the sender bit flips in phase B the system enters phase A.          *)
LEMMA AbpCBMove ==
  ASSUME AbpInv, ~AbpCA, [Next]_vars, sender_bit' # sender_bit
  PROVE  /\ sender_bit' = receiver_bit'
         /\ receiver_i' = receiver_i
         /\ sender_gen_i' >= sender_gen_i
  <1> USE DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpMsgSet, AbpCA
  <1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r30") DEF vars
  <1>2. CASE \E v \in DataValue : GenerateData(v)
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r30") DEF GenerateData
  <1>3. CASE SenderSendData
    BY <1>3, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderSendData
  <1>4. CASE SenderReceiveAck
    BY <1>4, SMTT("r30") DEF SenderReceiveAck
  <1>5. CASE ReceiverReceiveData
    <2>1. /\ Len(data_chan) \in Nat

  <1>7. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(data_chan) : DataMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>7, SMTT("r30") DEF DataMsgDrop
  <1>8. CASE \E i \in 1..Len(ack_chan) : AckMsgDrop(i)
    BY <1>8, SMTT("r30") DEF AckMsgDrop
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next

  ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AbpNSD(k), sender_bit' = sender_bit,
         \A p \in 1..Len(data_chan') :

           \/ \E r \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
                r >= p /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]

  <1>2. CASE data_chan'[p].bit = sender_bit
    BY <1>2
  <1>3. CASE \E r \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
               r >= p /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
    <2>1. PICK r \in 1..Len(data_chan) :
            r >= p /\ data_chan'[p] = data_chan[r]
      BY <1>3
    <2>2. r > k
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r30")
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AbpNSD
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

AbpHA(m) == AbpFairInv /\ []AbpSA(m)
AbpHB(m) == AbpFairInv /\ []AbpSB(m)

AbpXA(m, k)  == (AbpHA(m) /\ AbpNSD(k)) => FALSE
AbpXB(m, k)  == (AbpHB(m) /\ AbpNSA(k)) => FALSE
AbpXA0(m)    == AbpHA(m) => FALSE
AbpXB0(m)    == AbpHB(m) => FALSE
AbpFlA(m, k) == [] AbpXA(m, k)
AbpFlB(m, k) == [] AbpXB(m, k)

AbpLeadA(m)  == AbpFairInv => (AbpSA(m) ~> AbpQ(m))
AbpLeadB(m)  == AbpFairInv => (AbpSB(m) ~> AbpSA(m))
AbpLeadAt(m) == AbpFairInv => (AbpAt(m) ~> AbpQ(m))
AbpReach(n)  == AbpFairInv => ((sender_gen_i > n) ~> (receiver_i > n))

AbpDeliver(i)     == (sender_array[i] # Bot) ~> (receiver_array[i] # Bot)
AbpSpecDeliver(i) == Spec => AbpDeliver(i)

LEMMA AbpInfRecv ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpHA(m) => []<>(<< ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars)
  <1>1. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) => ENABLED << SenderSendData >>_vars
    BY AbpEnSend DEF AbpSA
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ << SenderSendData >>_vars => (data_chan # << >>)'
    BY AbpSendNE
  <1>3. AbpInv /\ (data_chan # << >>) => ENABLED << ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars
    BY AbpEnRecv
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF AbpHA, AbpFairInv, AbpFair

LEMMA AbpInfRAck ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpHB(m) => []<>(<< SenderReceiveAck >>_vars)
  <1>1. AbpInv => ENABLED << ReceiverSendAck >>_vars
    BY AbpEnSendAck
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ << ReceiverSendAck >>_vars => (ack_chan # << >>)'
    BY AbpAckNE
  <1>3. AbpInv /\ (ack_chan # << >>) => ENABLED << SenderReceiveAck >>_vars
    BY AbpEnRAck
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF AbpHB, AbpFairInv, AbpFair

LEMMA AbpXABase ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpXA(m, 0)
  <1>1. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) /\ AbpNSD(0) /\ [Next]_vars
          => (AbpNSD(0)' \/ AbpQ(m)')
    BY AbpNSDStep
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) /\ AbpNSD(0) /\ << ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars
          => AbpQ(m)'
    BY AbpNSD0
  <1>3. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) => ~AbpQ(m)
    BY AbpAtNotQ DEF AbpSA
  <1>4. AbpHA(m) => []<>(<< ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars)
    BY AbpInfRecv
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, PTL DEF AbpXA, AbpHA, AbpFairInv, AbpFair

LEMMA AbpXBBase ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpXB(m, 0)
  <1>1. AbpInv /\ AbpSB(m) /\ AbpNSA(0) /\ [Next]_vars
          => (AbpNSA(0)' \/ AbpSA(m)')
    BY AbpNSAStep
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ AbpSB(m) /\ AbpNSA(0) /\ << SenderReceiveAck >>_vars
          => AbpSA(m)'
    BY AbpNSA0
  <1>3. AbpSB(m) => ~AbpSA(m)
    BY DEF AbpSA, AbpSB
  <1>4. AbpHB(m) => []<>(<< SenderReceiveAck >>_vars)
    BY AbpInfRAck
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, PTL DEF AbpXB, AbpHB, AbpFairInv, AbpFair

LEMMA AbpFlABase ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat

  <1>1. AbpXA(m, 0)

  <1> QED

LEMMA AbpFlBBase ==

  PROVE  AbpFlB(m, 0)

  <1> QED

LEMMA AbpFlAStep ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpFlA(m, k) => AbpFlA(m, k + 1)
  <1>1. AbpFlA(m, k) => AbpXA(m, k + 1)
    <2>1. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) /\ AbpNSD(k + 1) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AbpNSD(k + 1)' \/ AbpQ(m)')
      BY AbpNSDStep
    <2>2. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) /\ AbpNSD(k + 1) /\ << ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars
            => (AbpNSD(k)' \/ AbpQ(m)')
      BY AbpNSDDec
    <2>3. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) => ~AbpQ(m)
      BY AbpAtNotQ DEF AbpSA
    <2>4. AbpHA(m) => []<>(<< ReceiverReceiveData >>_vars)
      BY AbpInfRecv
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, PTL
      DEF AbpFlA, AbpXA, AbpHA, AbpFairInv, AbpFair
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, PTL DEF AbpFlA

LEMMA AbpFlBStep ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpFlB(m, k) => AbpFlB(m, k + 1)
  <1>1. AbpFlB(m, k) => AbpXB(m, k + 1)
    <2>1. AbpInv /\ AbpSB(m) /\ AbpNSA(k + 1) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (AbpNSA(k + 1)' \/ AbpSA(m)')
      BY AbpNSAStep
    <2>2. AbpInv /\ AbpSB(m) /\ AbpNSA(k + 1) /\ << SenderReceiveAck >>_vars
            => (AbpNSA(k)' \/ AbpSA(m)')
      BY AbpNSADec
    <2>3. AbpSB(m) => ~AbpSA(m)
      BY DEF AbpSA, AbpSB
    <2>4. AbpHB(m) => []<>(<< SenderReceiveAck >>_vars)
      BY AbpInfRAck
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, PTL
      DEF AbpFlB, AbpXB, AbpHB, AbpFairInv, AbpFair
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, PTL DEF AbpFlB

LEMMA AbpXA0L ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpXA0(m)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME AbpHA(m) PROVE FALSE
    BY DEF AbpXA0
  <1>1. AbpInv
    BY PTL DEF AbpHA, AbpFairInv
  <1>2. \A k \in Nat : AbpXA(m, k)
    BY AbpXAAll
  <1>3. \E k \in Nat : AbpNSD(k)
    <2>1. Len(data_chan) \in Nat

    <2>2. AbpNSD(Len(data_chan))
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r30") DEF AbpNSD
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1> QED
    BY <1>2, <1>3 DEF AbpXA

LEMMA AbpXB0L ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpXB0(m)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME AbpHB(m) PROVE FALSE
    BY DEF AbpXB0
  <1>1. AbpInv

  <1>2. \A k \in Nat : AbpXB(m, k)
    BY AbpXBAll
  <1>3. \E k \in Nat : AbpNSA(k)
    <2>1. Len(ack_chan) \in Nat

    <2>2. AbpNSA(Len(ack_chan))
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r30") DEF AbpNSA
    <2> QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2

    BY <1>2, <1>3 DEF AbpXB

LEMMA AbpLeadAL ==

  <1>2. AbpInv /\ AbpSA(m) /\ [Next]_vars => (AbpSA(m)' \/ AbpQ(m)')

  <1>3. AbpInv /\ AbpQ(m) /\ [Next]_vars => AbpQ(m)'
    BY AbpQStep
  <1> QED

LEMMA AbpLeadAtL ==

  <1> QED

    DEF AbpLeadAt, AbpLeadA, AbpLeadB, AbpFairInv

LEMMA AbpReachBase == AbpReach(0)
  <1>1. AbpLeadAt(0)
    BY AbpLeadAtL
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ (sender_gen_i > 0) => ((receiver_i > 0) \/ AbpAt(0))
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpAt
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF AbpReach, AbpLeadAt, AbpQ, AbpFairInv

LEMMA AbpReachStep ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat
  PROVE  AbpReach(n) => AbpReach(n + 1)
  <1>1. AbpInv /\ (sender_gen_i > n + 1) => (sender_gen_i > n)
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ (sender_gen_i > n + 1) /\ [Next]_vars
          => (sender_gen_i > n + 1)'
    BY AbpGenStable
  <1>3. AbpInv /\ (receiver_i > n) /\ (sender_gen_i > n + 1)
          => ((receiver_i > n + 1) \/ AbpAt(n + 1))
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK, AbpAt
  <1>4. AbpLeadAt(n + 1)
    BY AbpLeadAtL
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME AbpReach(n), AbpFairInv
               PROVE  (sender_gen_i > n + 1) ~> (receiver_i > n + 1)
    BY DEF AbpReach
  <1>5. (sender_gen_i > n) ~> (receiver_i > n)
    BY PTL DEF AbpReach
  <1>6. (sender_gen_i > n + 1) ~> (receiver_i > n)
    BY <1>1, <1>5, PTL DEF AbpFairInv
  <1>7. (sender_gen_i > n + 1) ~> ((receiver_i > n) /\ (sender_gen_i > n + 1))
    BY <1>2, <1>6, PTL DEF AbpFairInv, AbpFair
  <1>8. (sender_gen_i > n + 1) ~> ((receiver_i > n + 1) \/ AbpAt(n + 1))
    BY <1>3, <1>7, PTL DEF AbpFairInv
  <1>9. AbpAt(n + 1) ~> (receiver_i > n + 1)
    BY <1>4, PTL DEF AbpLeadAt, AbpQ
  <1> QED
    BY <1>8, <1>9, PTL

LEMMA AbpReachAll == \A n \in Nat : AbpReach(n)
  <1> DEFINE P(n) == AbpReach(n)
  <1>1. P(0)
    BY AbpReachBase
  <1>2. \A n \in Nat : P(n) => P(n + 1)
    BY AbpReachStep
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, AbpNI!NatInduction

LEMMA AbpSpecFair == Spec => AbpFairInv
  <1>1. Init => AbpInv
    BY AbpInitInv
  <1>2. AbpInv /\ [Next]_vars => AbpInv'
    BY AbpNextInv
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, AbpFairInv, AbpFair

LEMMA AbpDeliverAll == \A i \in Nat : AbpSpecDeliver(i)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Nat PROVE AbpSpecDeliver(i)
    OBVIOUS
  <1>1. AbpReach(i)
    BY AbpReachAll
  <1>2. Spec => AbpFairInv
    BY AbpSpecFair
  <1>3. AbpInv /\ (sender_array[i] # Bot) => (sender_gen_i > i)
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK
  <1>4. AbpInv /\ (receiver_i > i) => (receiver_array[i] # Bot)
    BY SMTT("r30") DEF AbpInv, AbpTypeOK
  <1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, PTL
    DEF AbpSpecDeliver, AbpDeliver, AbpReach, AbpFairInv
